title: Zinc determination in aqueous samples using energy-dispersive X-ray fluorescence spectrometry after magnetic solid-phase microextraction using Fe3O4 nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9569-9575
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01224D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Guillermo Roth, Javier Silva, Ricardo Faccio, Mariela Pistón
A novel analytical method for zinc (Zn) determination in aqueous samples was developed and validated using magnetic solid-phase microextraction (MSPME) combined with element detection via energy-dispersive X-ray fluorescence (EDXRF).
